<strong>royale</strong> — l'image la plu: regal — the sharpest image, but a flicker at every page change. Pleasant to look at, tiring for long reading.
<strong>Par défaut</strong> — le réglage: Default — the tablet's original setting, halfway between. This is what caused the flickering you may have noticed.
<strong>rapide</strong> — celui que nous: fast — the one we install. No flicker, at the cost of a faint trace of the previous text, which you forget as you read.
<strong>Vitesse maximale</strong> — <str: Maximum speed — avoid. The screen goes faster still, but it leaves ghosting: the ghosts of previous pages build up and end up getting in the way of reading.
Ce réglage appartient à la tablette, pas: This setting belongs to the tablet, not to NUR: it applies to everything on the screen. If you change it, NUR respects your choice and does not put it back to "fast" at the next start.
